Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment uses AP-MS to identify the interactome of OTUB1 and specifically analyzes the asparagine hydroxylation (N22) of OTUB1. While the study discusses deubiquitinases, the MS assay itself is an affinity purification (AP-MS) and PTM analysis, not a diGly/ubiquitin remnant enrichment.

scope: Immunoprecipitation was carried out as previously described. Briefly, cell lysates were incubated with the antibody-coupled beads anti-FLAG M2 affinity gel (Sigma) at 4°C for 1 h.
The cells were lysed and we immunoprecipitated the protein with anti-FLAG agarose for 1 hour.
Following immunoprecipitation of OTUB1 (demonstrated in Fig 4B) we identified the OTUB1 WT and the OTUB1 N22A interactomes by mass spectrometry.
